column3: Kuroneko Route · Completely Disregarded Hardships
This is the first time I have felt like this... it's really unbearable to be completely ignored by someone.
Y-Yo...
Completely ignored... huh.
Good grief... It's kinda depressing when I consider the possibility that this could last forever...
I know I'm letting down Saori who's counting on me... But after she said that to me, what am I supposed to do?
Manami overestimated me too... If that's the wishes of the person concerned, there's nothing I can do!
I have also let Kirino down... But, I'm sure you'll be fine.
You and Kuroneko's friendship won't be broken by something like that...
But, as for me...
...*sigh*
Say, I've heard this from my sister today.
Yeah...
That girl... looks like she's in terrible shape...
...Terrible?
Seems like she's constantly pushing her limits.
And she continues to drive herself, reaching her limits... a vicious cycle.
Sounds like the worst pattern.
Yes, a splendid route to self-destruction.
The senpai at the club wanted to stop her... but it seems she doesn't listen at all, right?
I would have stopped her earlier if it were so simple.
...That's true.
Oh really...
If Kuroneko is being pressured, I would like to support her. Even now that feeling hasn't changed.
But... if the person in question doesn't desire help, what would happen if I were to help her?
I'm still unable to find an answer to that...
...That's right... If I were to ask Akagi who's not really related to Kuroneko... Would that be good?
No, I should stop.... It's not like I have something to leisurely talk about....
And, also... This is something I must get the answer to by myself.
That's why...
Hey, Akagi...?
Hmm? What is it?
This is just theoretically speaking, okay?
Hmm? Yeah.
What if, from a glance you can tell your sister's trying to force herself...
...And quarreled with her friend, saying it was all for the sake of production...
It's painful to look at, so you wanted to stop her, but were told not to interfere in return...
At that point... what would you do?
My sister would never say something like that!
...Thanks for reacting just like what I expected.
I won't ask you again.
Hey hey, did I say anything strange just now?
I'm hanging up-
W-Wait! Hey, Kousaka.
If my sister is being reckless, wouldn't it be more or less the same for anyone, doing what an elder brother would do?
...Eh? Well... I guess so.
That girl... She's 【like a little sister】 to you, isn't it?
Little sister... Kuroneko isn't my sister...
Which reminds me, Kuroneko herself once said something similar before...
I thought about it... If you're my sister, it'll turn out like this?
Why are you staring at me? Gross.
Kuroneko would be like her...
What are you looking at? Gross.
...Something like that?
That would be... rather unpleasant.
Really? But isn't she your 【cute kouhai】?
Say, Akagi, I'm really worried about you now.
Why does 'cute kouhai' equal 'little sister'?
Huh? Why?
Then let me ask you again, Akagi, why do you see people you are concerned about and younger than you as little sisters?
You sure are being disrespectful... I only have one single sister!
I know that!
I'm hanging up.
Okay, I don't really get it, but good luck anyway.
...But what are you planning to do?
Who knows...
I guess I'll try thinking about it some more. See ya.
They intend to ban her from entering the clubroom... Though I doubt having her overexert herself somewhere people can't monitor is any
better.
